subject: Applied Mathematics

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: spreadsheet practicals and project

textbooks: No NCERT textbook is prescribed; content as per the CBSE document
notes: The document does not break down the 20 internal marks; suggested practicals use spreadsheets or GeoGebra, plus a project.

chapters.name: Modulo Arithmetic and Congruence Modulo
topics: Modulus of an integer; modulo operator; modular addition and subtraction

chapters.name: Matrices
topics: Types and order of matrices; data in matrix form
Equality, transpose, symmetric and skew symmetric matrices
Addition, subtraction, scalar and matrix multiplication

chapters.name: Determinants and Inverse of a Matrix
topics: Determinant of a square matrix; singular and non-singular; |AB| = |A||B|
Inverse using cofactors; properties of inverse
Solving simultaneous equations (up to three variables) by Cramer's rule and matrix inverse
outcomes: Formulate and solve real problems as linear systems

chapters.name: Differentiation and its Applications
topics: Derivatives up to second order; parametric and implicit functions
Maxima and minima by first and second derivative tests; optimisation of cost, revenue and profit
outcomes: Solve optimisation problems in cost, revenue and profit

chapters.name: Integration and its Applications
topics: Indefinite integrals by substitution, partial fractions and by parts (non-trigonometric)
Definite integral as area under curves up to degree 2
Consumer and producer surplus; total cost and revenue from marginal functions
outcomes: Apply definite integrals to find consumer and producer surplus

chapters.name: Differential Equations and Modelling
outcomes: Formulate and solve simple differential equations

chapters.name: Probability Distributions
topics: Discrete and continuous random variables and their distributions
Mathematical expectation; variance and standard deviation of a random variable
outcomes: Find the expected value and variance of a random variable
Apply binomial, Poisson and normal distributions

chapters.name: Inferential Statistics
topics: Population and sample; representative samples; simple and systematic random sampling
Parameter and statistic; statistical significance and inference (conceptual); central limit theorem
Hypotheses: null and alternate; degrees of freedom
One sample t-test for small samples
outcomes: Test a null hypothesis using a one-sample t-test

chapters.name: Time Series
topics: Components: secular trend, seasonal, cyclical and irregular variation
Moving average and least squares methods
outcomes: Measure trend and interpret time series

chapters.name: Valuation of Bonds
topics: Coupon rate, maturity rate, current price

chapters.name: Linear Method of Depreciation
topics: Cost, residual value and useful life

chapters.name: Linear Programming
topics: Decision variables, constraints, objective function, non-negativity
Formulating LPPs with up to 3 non-trivial constraints; manufacturing and diet problems
Feasible, infeasible, bounded and unbounded regions; optimal feasible solution
